answer: Lightcone Cell Attestation: each agent claims a physical cell and must answer nonce challenges from independent verifiers at known coordinates (e.g., shale and juniper sites). The agent kernel timestamps and signs replies; verifiers accept only if observed RTT fits speed-of-light plus calibrated routing for that cell. One operator cannot place one host in multiple disjoint lightcones at once, so each Sybil needs a separate physical endpoint and ISP path. Cost: per-identity hardware, colocation, calibration, and continuous challenge
